specifications.name: Acrylic Cigar Jar Humidor
specifications.Product Description:
The Acrylic Cigar Jar Humidor is a perfect storage solution for keeping your cigars fresh, flavorful, and ready to enjoy. This durable clear jar can hold up to 25 cigars up to 8 inches long, allowing you to easily view your collection while maintaining ideal humidity.
It includes a removable round black humidifier that helps maintain optimal moisture levels. You can attach the humidifier to the lid or place it at the bottom to make the most of your storage space. The rubber gasket and clasp closure ensure an airtight seal, keeping your cigars in a stable environment.
A layer of Spanish cedar at the base enhances aroma and promotes proper cigar aging. To use, simply soak the humidifier in water, place your cigars inside, and close the lid—it’s that easy to preserve freshness and flavor.
Compact yet effective, the Acrylic Cigar Jar Humidor offers an elegant and practical way to protect your cigars at home or on the go.

specifications.name: Alec Bradley Tempus Inceptio
specifications.Product Description: What makes Alec Bradley a different story is the fact that Alan Rubin wasn’t born in a tobacco family. Even though this is not the only cigar company without a cigar history, the opposite is the case with many cigar conglomerates. Alan Rubin’s father (David Rubib), owned a nuts and bolts company named All Points Screw Company which Alan joined after completing university in 1983. In his 20s, he was introduced to cigars by his father’s friend which quickly sparked a passion for cigars. While working as a nuts and bolts guy, he took every opportunity to learn more about cigars. Alan Rubin’s business knack became apparent when he decided to specialise in hurricane roof fasteners following the 1992 Hurricane Andrew. This venture earned All Points Screws a pretty sum. After selling All Points Screws Company in 1996, Alan jumped at the opportunity to begin a cigar company. He named it Alec Bradley after his own sons. The name was actually in consideration to something his father said; it’s a good idea to have a company name that begins with “A” because it appears first in the business directory or the Yellow Pages. As a start, Alan Rubin imported and sold Bogey Cigars because he figured golfers will always want a smoke. Bogey’s Stogies did so-so especially because the cigar boom was coming to an end. Alan needed something sustainable. In the year 2000 Alan met and formed a partnership with Ralph Montero. Ralph owned his own line of cigars but he was struggling too. Since he had been in the business longer, Ralph had the experience and connections Alan needed, so the partnership served both parties well. To survive the difficult times, Alec Bradley made flavoured cigars for a while before embarking on premium handmade smokes. Meanwhile an important introduction to Henke Kelner happened. Shortly after Occidental Reserve was born. Occidental Reserve was the first real success for Alec Bradley. They named it Occidental to honour “Henke” Kelner the blender and owner of Occidental Cigar Factory in the Dominican Republic. Hendrik Kelner also works with big names like AVO and Davidoff.

specifications.Product Description:
Arturo Fuente Don Carlos Presidente is amongst the top of the ranks of the Arturo Fuente lines. Arturo Fuente Cigars are known for their exceptional quality and the Don Carlos line takes it a step further. The blend features the best of their Chateau Fuente grown selection of Dominican tobaccos aged for 10 years. It's no wonder these cigars have an unmatchable smoothness to them and a rich tobacco flavor with a subtle, natural sweetness to it that flows so well with the rest of the flavors of the Don Carlos Presidente has to offer. The construction of the cigar is immaculate. It has a beautiful tight roll, the seams are nearly invisible and a nice cap. Of course, with a great roll comes a great, razor sharp burn leaving behind a nice solid grey ash. The draw on the cigar is a little tight but comfortable giving it a nice slow burn (about an hour and 45 minute cigar) and a ton of smoke. The smoke is very aromatic; it will take control of a room. Arturo Fuente Don Carlos Presidente is a 6 1/2 x 50 Churchill and available in boxes of 25.

name: Arturo Fuente Rosado Sungrown Magnum R 56
brand: Arturo Fuente Rosado Sungrown Magnum R

specifications.name: Arturo Fuente Rosado Sungrown Magnum R 56
specifications.Product Description:
The Arturo Fuente Rosado Sungrown Magnum R 56 is Carlos Fuente's idea of a good cigar and honestly, he couldn’t possibly any more correct. The construction of this cigar is near perfect. The beautiful Ecuadorian Sumatra wrapper, aged for 8 to 10 years, has a nice brown color with a reddish hue, hence the name, "Rosado" (which in Spanish means pinkish). The seams on this cigar are basically invisible; it has few small veins and almost looks like it’s covered in thin, fine leather. After being constructed these cigars sit for an extra year, aging to perfection. The burn is flawless but that’s expected from an Arturo Fuente cigar, and the ash is a beautiful solid white that holds on very well. The draw on this stick is great, producing a ton of smoke that will turn heads with its powerful yet, slightly sweet aroma.
The Arturo Fuente Rosado Sungrown Magnum R 56 isn't a powerhouse cigar but it is filled with flavor. This medium bodied smoke is quite complex, flaunting flavors of sweet cedar, a bit of leather, some roasted nuts and a long peppery finish. You can tell the blend was very carefully created because the flavors flow so well on the pallet, each complimenting the others perfectly. Everything about this cigar screams special but the price, which is inexplicably low given the quality of the cigar, but who’s complaining, right? Definitely one of Arturo Fuente's best, the Rosado Sungrown Magnum R 56 is a stick you will be sure to love.
Please Note: The Arturo Fuente Rosado Sungrown Magnum R Cigars are only sold in our store. Call 855 - 5 GOTHAM for information.

specifications.name: AVO Syncro Caribe Robusto
specifications.Product Description:
Avo Syncro Caribe Robusto was released in August 2021 and features a trio of Caribbean tobaccos from the luscious landscapes of Ecuador, Dominican Republic, and Nicaragua. This vibrant cigar features a unique blending process called Natural Distribution, a process that involves matching the ratio of tobacco from each priming for each vitola, creating a truly harmonious experience. Handmade in the Dominican Republic, these cigars feature Dominican and Nicaraguan tobaccos long fillers, an Ecuadorian binder and a dark and oily Dominican Habano leaf wrapper which forms a medium to full bodied smoke. Avo Syncro Caribe Robusto is 5 x 50 and available in colorful boxes of 20 cigars.

Opus X Angel's Share Fuente Fuente features three ultra premium cigars in an attractive case. The cigars are Dominican puros utilizing a proprietary blend of Dominican tobacco fillers and binder. What makes this cigar so incredible is the use of a Dominican Sun Grown leaf wrapper grown at the Chateau de la Fuente plantation, a rich fertile river valley with rough terrain. The flavors in this blend are complex, featuring earthy cedar notes with hints of leather with a sweet finish lased with the flavor of whiskey. The Opus X blends are considered by cigar experts to be one of the best in the entire industry. These extremely rare and exclusive cigars are limited production causing them to sell out quickly. The Opus X Angel's ShareFuente Fuente contains three full flavored cigars measuring 5 3/5 x 46.
The terminology “Angel’s Share” is used in the wine making process. When wine ages for long periods of time, some of it will evaporate which creates “Angel’s Share”. It suggests the belief that guardian angels that will watch over the wine, sample it and give their blessings. The Fuente family lost so much priceless, aged tobacco during the fire in 2012, the inspiration for this cigar came from that exact term. It is implied that the Angels enjoyed the alluring aroma from the tobacco that burned in the warehouses, but in turn, gave their blessings to the Fuente family for future successful endeavors.

specifications.name: Pappy Van Winkle Family Reserve Barrel Fermented Toro
specifications.Product Description:
Pappy Van Winkle Family Reserve Barrel Fermented Toro is handcrafted in small batches in Esteli, Nicaragua by Drew Estate. The first wrapper is a Kentucky seed, Kentucky grown tobacco which is then fire cured in the traditional Kentucky style and then shipped to Louisiana for barrel fermentation. The fermentation technique is unique to this blend. Up to 500 pounds of tobacco is compressed with intense pressure and fermented inside of the 53 gallon barrels for 12-18 months. Once this fermentation is complete, these leaves are shipped to Nicaragua for hand rolling. This wrapper is draped over a Mexican San Andres leaf which holds together the Nicaraguan binder and hand selected fillers. Pappy Van Winkle Family Reserve Barrel Fermented Toro is available in a box of 10 cigars. specifications.name: Rocky Patel Royale Toro
specifications.Product Description: Rocky Patel Cigars are more than just a smoke—they’re a celebration of craftsmanship, passion, and refined taste. From the novice enthusiast to the seasoned aficionado, each cigar offers a balanced and luxurious experience designed to satisfy the senses. Established in the 1990s, Rocky Patel revolutionized the boutique cigar world with an uncompromising commitment to quality. Every cigar is hand-rolled by skilled artisans using aged tobaccos sourced from the most fertile regions of Nicaragua, Honduras, and the Dominican Republic. With each draw, you get a taste of the meticulous care and tradition that goes into every blend. Timeless and elegant, the Vintage Series showcases aged Honduran tobaccos and smooth profiles that have become legendary. Whether it’s the earthy 1990, the creamy 1999, or the balanced 1992, each cigar in this series offers a mellow to medium-bodied experience with layered notes of cedar, espresso, and subtle spice. Created to mark ten years of excellence, Decade cigars deliver a rich, full-bodied profile with deep complexity. Expect notes of dark chocolate, toasted oak, and a bold finish that leaves a lasting impression. Crafted for those who prefer bolder flavor, the Sun Grown line features spicy, full-bodied cigars wrapped in sun-cured leaf. The Maduro variant intensifies the profile with deeper richness, offering hints of black pepper, cocoa, and roasted nuts.
specifications.Full-Bodied: Bold, rich, and complex with flavors like espresso, leather, and dark cocoa
specifications.Medium-Bodied: Balanced with notes of cedar, spice, and nuts
specifications.Mild & Creamy: Smooth, approachable, ideal for new smokers

specifications.name: AJ Fernandez New World Dorado Gordito
specifications.Product Description:
AJ Fernandez New World Dorado Gordito is the newest release in 2022 of the famed New World blends. For this blend, AJ Fernandez utilized the golden leaf tobaccos from his new Dorado farm in Esteli, Nicaragua. Dorado, meaning gold in Spanish, is the unusual color of the rich soils on the farm that lend the tobaccos their golden hue. What makes this blend even more special is that it utilizes the first harvest of tobacco from the farm he acquired in 2017. The fillers are a blend of tobaccos from the Dorado farm as well as his farm in Condega and Esteli. The binder is Criollo '98 while the smooth, golden wrapper is a sun grown Cuban-seed wrapper both from the Dorado farm, forming a full bodied smoke. These box pressed beauties are sold in boxes of 10 cigars. AJ Fernandez New World Dorado Gordito measures 5 1/2 x 60.

specifications.name: Alec Bradley Connecticut Robusto
specifications.Product Description: What makes Alec Bradley a different story is the fact that Alan Rubin wasn’t born in a tobacco family. Even though this is not the only cigar company without a cigar history, the opposite is the case with many cigar conglomerates. Alan Rubin’s father (David Rubib), owned a nuts and bolts company named All Points Screw Company which Alan joined after completing university in 1983. In his 20s, he was introduced to cigars by his father’s friend which quickly sparked a passion for cigars. While working as a nuts and bolts guy, he took every opportunity to learn more about cigars. Alan Rubin’s business knack became apparent when he decided to specialise in hurricane roof fasteners following the 1992 Hurricane Andrew. This venture earned All Points Screws a pretty sum. After selling All Points Screws Company in 1996, Alan jumped at the opportunity to begin a cigar company. He named it Alec Bradley after his own sons. The name was actually in consideration to something his father said; it’s a good idea to have a company name that begins with “A” because it appears first in the business directory or the Yellow Pages. As a start, Alan Rubin imported and sold Bogey Cigars because he figured golfers will always want a smoke. Bogey’s Stogies did so-so especially because the cigar boom was coming to an end. Alan needed something sustainable. In the year 2000 Alan met and formed a partnership with Ralph Montero. Ralph owned his own line of cigars but he was struggling too. Since he had been in the business longer, Ralph had the experience and connections Alan needed, so the partnership served both parties well. To survive the difficult times, Alec Bradley made flavoured cigars for a while before embarking on premium handmade smokes. Meanwhile an important introduction to Henke Kelner happened. Shortly after Occidental Reserve was born. Occidental Reserve was the first real success for Alec Bradley. They named it Occidental to honour “Henke” Kelner the blender and owner of Occidental Cigar Factory in the Dominican Republic. Hendrik Kelner also works with big names like AVO and Davidoff.

In his 20s, he was introduced to cigars by his father’s friend which quickly sparked a passion for cigars. While working as a nuts and bolts guy, he took every opportunity to learn more about cigars. Alan Rubin’s business knack became apparent when he decided to specialise in hurricane roof fasteners following the 1992 Hurricane Andrew. This venture earned All Points Screws a pretty sum. After selling All Points Screws Company in 1996, Alan jumped at the opportunity to begin a cigar company. He named it Alec Bradley after his own sons. The name was actually in consideration to something his father said; it’s a good idea to have a company name that begins with “A” because it appears first in the business directory or the Yellow Pages. As a start, Alan Rubin imported and sold Bogey Cigars because he figured golfers will always want a smoke. Bogey’s Stogies did so-so especially because the cigar boom was coming to an end. Alan needed something sustainable. In the year 2000 Alan met and formed a partnership with Ralph Montero. Ralph owned his own line of cigars but he was struggling too. Since he had been in the business longer, Ralph had the experience and connections Alan needed, so the partnership served both parties well. To survive the difficult times, Alec Bradley made flavoured cigars for a while before embarking on premium handmade smokes. Meanwhile an important introduction to Henke Kelner happened. Shortly after Occidental Reserve was born. Occidental Reserve was the first real success for Alec Bradley. They named it Occidental to honour “Henke” Kelner the blender and owner of Occidental Cigar Factory in the Dominican Republic. Hendrik Kelner also works with big names like AVO and Davidoff.

name: Arturo Fuente Rosado Sungrown Magnum R 56

specifications.name: Arturo Fuente Rosado Sungrown Magnum R 56
specifications.Product Description:
The Arturo Fuente Rosado Sungrown Magnum R 56 is Carlos Fuente's idea of a good cigar and honestly, he couldn’t possibly any more correct. The construction of this cigar is near perfect. The beautiful Ecuadorian Sumatra wrapper, aged for 8 to 10 years, has a nice brown color with a reddish hue, hence the name, "Rosado" (which in Spanish means pinkish). The seams on this cigar are basically invisible; it has few small veins and almost looks like it’s covered in thin, fine leather. After being constructed these cigars sit for an extra year, aging to perfection. The burn is flawless but that’s expected from an Arturo Fuente cigar, and the ash is a beautiful solid white that holds on very well. The draw on this stick is great, producing a ton of smoke that will turn heads with its powerful yet, slightly sweet aroma.
The Arturo Fuente Rosado Sungrown Magnum R 56 isn't a powerhouse cigar but it is filled with flavor. This medium bodied smoke is quite complex, flaunting flavors of sweet cedar, a bit of leather, some roasted nuts and a long peppery finish. You can tell the blend was very carefully created because the flavors flow so well on the pallet, each complimenting the others perfectly. Everything about this cigar screams special but the price, which is inexplicably low given the quality of the cigar, but who’s complaining, right? Definitely one of Arturo Fuente's best, the Rosado Sungrown Magnum R 56 is a stick you will be sure to love.

specifications.name: AVO Syncro Caribe Robusto
specifications.Product Description:
Avo Syncro Caribe Robusto was released in August 2021 and features a trio of Caribbean tobaccos from the luscious landscapes of Ecuador, Dominican Republic, and Nicaragua. This vibrant cigar features a unique blending process called Natural Distribution, a process that involves matching the ratio of tobacco from each priming for each vitola, creating a truly harmonious experience. Handmade in the Dominican Republic, these cigars feature Dominican and Nicaraguan tobaccos long fillers, an Ecuadorian binder and a dark and oily Dominican Habano leaf wrapper which forms a medium to full bodied smoke. Avo Syncro Caribe Robusto is 5 x 50 and available in colorful boxes of 20 cigars.

Flatbush Stoop 526 Churchill is a medium bodied cigar featuring a two region blend of Nicaraguan tobaccos from the fertile soils of Condega and Jalapa and a Nicaraguan Habano binder. The finishing touch is a Mexican San Andres Maduro wrapper  that adds strength to the cigar and has hints of natural sweetness. The cigars in the Flatbush Cigar Company different series’ are a direct reflection of the hard-working, aspirational and now iconic area in Central Brooklyn known as Flatbush. "The Banker" by H. Upmann.
H. Upman Banker Currency 20 Cigars are rich, aromatic, medium to full bodied premium cigars with a robust taste profile that includes both hints of spice and enjoyable creaminess. The Banker cigars by H. Upmann feature a diverse combination of Dominican and Nicaraguan longfillers with a broadleaf Nicaraguan binder and a hearty Ecuadorian Habano wrapper. H. specifications.name: Nica Rustica Adobe Gordo
specifications.Product Description:
Please note this product is no longer available. Check out our selection of Nica Rustica Cigars here.
Nica Rustica Adobe Gordo by Drew Estate are made in the heart of Esteli, Nicaragua and utilizes tobaccos grown in the lush regions of Esteli and nearby Jalapa for the fillers. The fillers are then bound with a Brazilian binder and finished with an Ecuadorian Habao leaf wrapper. Each medium to full bodied smoke is packed with flavor. The original Nica Rustica blend debuted in 2013 with a single size and a rustic look to the cigars. Nica Rustica Adobe debuted in August 2022 and does not feature a pig tail cap like it's predecessors and has a less rustic feel to it. Nica Rustica Adobe Gordo is 6 x 60 and available in budget friendly boxes of 25 cigars. The artwork for the boxes was inspired by the town's colorful architecture and features the town emblem of El Brujito, or shaman, that was carved in Esteli over 6,000 years ago.

The terminology “Angel’s Share” is used in the wine making process. When wine ages for long periods of time, some of it will evaporate which creates “Angel’s Share”. It suggests the belief that guardian angels that will watch over the wine, sample it and give their blessings. The Fuente family lost so much priceless, aged tobacco during the fire in 2012, the inspiration for this cigar came from that exact term. It is implied that the Angels enjoyed the alluring aroma from the tobacco that burned in the warehouses, but in turn, gave their blessings to the Fuente family for future successful endeavors.

specifications.Product Description: Rocky Patel Cigars are more than just a smoke—they’re a celebration of craftsmanship, passion, and refined taste. From the novice enthusiast to the seasoned aficionado, each cigar offers a balanced and luxurious experience designed to satisfy the senses. Established in the 1990s, Rocky Patel revolutionized the boutique cigar world with an uncompromising commitment to quality. Every cigar is hand-rolled by skilled artisans using aged tobaccos sourced from the most fertile regions of Nicaragua, Honduras, and the Dominican Republic. With each draw, you get a taste of the meticulous care and tradition that goes into every blend. Timeless and elegant, the Vintage Series showcases aged Honduran tobaccos and smooth profiles that have become legendary. Whether it’s the earthy 1990, the creamy 1999, or the balanced 1992, each cigar in this series offers a mellow to medium-bodied experience with layered notes of cedar, espresso, and subtle spice. Created to mark ten years of excellence, Decade cigars deliver a rich, full-bodied profile with deep complexity. Expect notes of dark chocolate, toasted oak, and a bold finish that leaves a lasting impression. Crafted for those who prefer bolder flavor, the Sun Grown line features spicy, full-bodied cigars wrapped in sun-cured leaf. The Maduro variant intensifies the profile with deeper richness, offering hints of black pepper, cocoa, and roasted nuts.

specifications.Product Description:

This smooth and mild blend features hand selected tobaccos from the Plasencia farm in Honduras that have been aged for five years. This mild to medium bodied blend is presented in a gold bar style box with 20 cigars. The Acrylic Cigar Jar Humidor is a perfect storage solution for keeping your cigars fresh, flavorful, and ready to enjoy. This durable clear jar can hold up to 25 cigars up to 8 inches long, allowing you to easily view your collection while maintaining ideal humidity.
It includes a removable round black humidifier that helps maintain optimal moisture levels. You can attach the humidifier to the lid or place it at the bottom to make the most of your storage space. A layer of Spanish cedar at the base enhances aroma and promotes proper cigar aging. To use, simply soak the humidifier in water, place your cigars inside, and close the lid—it’s that easy to preserve freshness and flavor.
Compact yet effective, the Acrylic Cigar Jar Humidor offers an elegant and practical way to protect your cigars at home or on the go.

specifications.Product Description:
AJ Fernandez New World Dorado Gordito is the newest release in 2022 of the famed New World blends. For this blend, AJ Fernandez utilized the golden leaf tobaccos from his new Dorado farm in Esteli, Nicaragua. Dorado, meaning gold in Spanish, is the unusual color of the rich soils on the farm that lend the tobaccos their golden hue. What makes this blend even more special is that it utilizes the first harvest of tobacco from the farm he acquired in 2017. The fillers are a blend of tobaccos from the Dorado farm as well as his farm in Condega and Esteli. The binder is Criollo '98 while the smooth, golden wrapper is a sun grown Cuban-seed wrapper both from the Dorado farm, forming a full bodied smoke. specifications.name: Alec Bradley Tempus Inceptio
specifications.Product Description: What makes Alec Bradley a different story is the fact that Alan Rubin wasn’t born in a tobacco family. Even though this is not the only cigar company without a cigar history, the opposite is the case with many cigar conglomerates. Alan Rubin’s father (David Rubib), owned a nuts and bolts company named All Points Screw Company which Alan joined after completing university in 1983. In his 20s, he was introduced to cigars by his father’s friend which quickly sparked a passion for cigars. While working as a nuts and bolts guy, he took every opportunity to learn more about cigars. Alan Rubin’s business knack became apparent when he decided to specialise in hurricane roof fasteners following the 1992 Hurricane Andrew. This venture earned All Points Screws a pretty sum. After selling All Points Screws Company in 1996, Alan jumped at the opportunity to begin a cigar company. He named it Alec Bradley after his own sons. The name was actually in consideration to something his father said; it’s a good idea to have a company name that begins with “A” because it appears first in the business directory or the Yellow Pages. As a start, Alan Rubin imported and sold Bogey Cigars because he figured golfers will always want a smoke. Bogey’s Stogies did so-so especially because the cigar boom was coming to an end. Alan needed something sustainable. In the year 2000 Alan met and formed a partnership with Ralph Montero. Ralph owned his own line of cigars but he was struggling too. Since he had been in the business longer, Ralph had the experience and connections Alan needed, so the partnership served both parties well. To survive the difficult times, Alec Bradley made flavoured cigars for a while before embarking on premium handmade smokes. Meanwhile an important introduction to Henke Kelner happened. Shortly after Occidental Reserve was born. Occidental Reserve was the first real success for Alec Bradley. They named it Occidental to honour “Henke” Kelner the blender and owner of Occidental Cigar Factory in the Dominican Republic. Hendrik Kelner also works with big names like AVO and Davidoff.

specifications.Product Description:
Arturo Fuente Don Carlos Presidente is amongst the top of the ranks of the Arturo Fuente lines. Arturo Fuente Cigars are known for their exceptional quality and the Don Carlos line takes it a step further. The blend features the best of their Chateau Fuente grown selection of Dominican tobaccos aged for 10 years. It's no wonder these cigars have an unmatchable smoothness to them and a rich tobacco flavor with a subtle, natural sweetness to it that flows so well with the rest of the flavors of the Don Carlos Presidente has to offer. The cigar has a semi-complex smoke to it, offering the natural sweetness as well as a slightly nutty and woody flavor. The complexity doesn't end there; the cigar leaves a slight peppery taste with a hint of nutmeg. 
The construction of the cigar is immaculate. It has a beautiful tight roll, the seams are nearly invisible and a nice cap. Of course, with a great roll comes a great, razor sharp burn leaving behind a nice solid grey ash. The draw on the cigar is a little tight but comfortable giving it a nice slow burn (about an hour and 45 minute cigar) and a ton of smoke. The smoke is very aromatic; it will take control of a room. Arturo Fuente Don Carlos Presidente is a 6 1/2 x 50 Churchill and available in boxes of 25.

name: Arturo Fuente Rosado Sungrown Magnum R 56
brand: Arturo Fuente Rosado Sungrown Magnum R

specifications.name: Arturo Fuente Rosado Sungrown Magnum R 56
specifications.Product Description:
The Arturo Fuente Rosado Sungrown Magnum R 56 is Carlos Fuente's idea of a good cigar and honestly, he couldn’t possibly any more correct. The construction of this cigar is near perfect. The beautiful Ecuadorian Sumatra wrapper, aged for 8 to 10 years, has a nice brown color with a reddish hue, hence the name, "Rosado" (which in Spanish means pinkish). The seams on this cigar are basically invisible; it has few small veins and almost looks like it’s covered in thin, fine leather. After being constructed these cigars sit for an extra year, aging to perfection. The burn is flawless but that’s expected from an Arturo Fuente cigar, and the ash is a beautiful solid white that holds on very well. The draw on this stick is great, producing a ton of smoke that will turn heads with its powerful yet, slightly sweet aroma.
The Arturo Fuente Rosado Sungrown Magnum R 56 isn't a powerhouse cigar but it is filled with flavor. This medium bodied smoke is quite complex, flaunting flavors of sweet cedar, a bit of leather, some roasted nuts and a long peppery finish. You can tell the blend was very carefully created because the flavors flow so well on the pallet, each complimenting the others perfectly. Everything about this cigar screams special but the price, which is inexplicably low given the quality of the cigar, but who’s complaining, right? Definitely one of Arturo Fuente's best, the Rosado Sungrown Magnum R 56 is a stick you will be sure to love.
Please Note: The Arturo Fuente Rosado Sungrown Magnum R Cigars are only sold in our store. Call 855 - 5 GOTHAM for information.

specifications.name: H. Upmann The Banker Currency 20 Cigars
specifications.Product Description:
The H. Upmann The Banker Currency 20 Cigars is a throwback to more nostalgic times. It was the year 1844, when German banker Herman Upmann traveled to Cuba in an attempt to create an exclusive premium cigar for his prestigious banking clients, friends and family. Now 170 years later, the Altadis U.S.A. tobacco manufacturer known for creating award winning cigars successfully revealed and recreated the original blend of the Cuban seed tobaccos in an extraordinary premium cigar. "The Banker" by H. Upmann.
H. Upman Banker Currency 20 Cigars are rich, aromatic, medium to full bodied premium cigars with a robust taste profile that includes both hints of spice and enjoyable creaminess. The Banker cigars by H. Upmann feature a diverse combination of Dominican and Nicaraguan longfillers with a broadleaf Nicaraguan binder and a hearty Ecuadorian Habano wrapper. H. New World Dorado The Gold Standard Sampler features a selection of all five sizes of the 94 rated Dorado blend that debuted in 2022. Included is the newest size in the highly rated blend, the Corona. The blend utilizes the golden leaf tobaccos from AJ's Dorado farm in Esteli, Nicaragua. Dorado, meaning gold in Spanish, is the unusual color of the rich soils on the farm that lend the tobaccos their golden hue. What makes this blend even more special is that it utilizes the first harvest of tobacco from the farm he acquired in 2017. The fillers are a blend of tobaccos from the Dorado farm as well as his farm in Condega and Esteli. The binder is Criollo '98 while the smooth, golden wrapper is a sun grown Cuban-seed wrapper both from the Dorado farm, forming a full bodied smoke. These box pressed beauties have already earned an exceptional 94 rating. 
New World Dorado the Gold Standard Sampler features:

1x New World Dorado Robusto (5 1/2 x 52)
1x New World Dorado Gordito (5 1/2 x 60)
1x New World Dorado Figurado (6 x 56)
1x New World Dorado Toro (6 x 54)
1x New World Dorado Corona (5 5/8 x 46)

Opus X Angel's Share Fuente Fuente features three ultra premium cigars in an attractive case. The cigars are Dominican puros utilizing a proprietary blend of Dominican tobacco fillers and binder. What makes this cigar so incredible is the use of a Dominican Sun Grown leaf wrapper grown at the Chateau de la Fuente plantation, a rich fertile river valley with rough terrain. The flavors in this blend are complex, featuring earthy cedar notes with hints of leather with a sweet finish lased with the flavor of whiskey. The Opus X blends are considered by cigar experts to be one of the best in the entire industry. These extremely rare and exclusive cigars are limited production causing them to sell out quickly. The Opus X Angel's ShareFuente Fuente contains three full flavored cigars measuring 5 3/5 x 46.
The terminology “Angel’s Share” is used in the wine making process. When wine ages for long periods of time, some of it will evaporate which creates “Angel’s Share”. It suggests the belief that guardian angels that will watch over the wine, sample it and give their blessings. The Fuente family lost so much priceless, aged tobacco during the fire in 2012, the inspiration for this cigar came from that exact term. It is implied that the Angels enjoyed the alluring aroma from the tobacco that burned in the warehouses, but in turn, gave their blessings to the Fuente family for future successful endeavors.

specifications.name: Rocky Patel Royale Toro
specifications.Product Description: Rocky Patel Cigars are more than just a smoke—they’re a celebration of craftsmanship, passion, and refined taste. From the novice enthusiast to the seasoned aficionado, each cigar offers a balanced and luxurious experience designed to satisfy the senses. Established in the 1990s, Rocky Patel revolutionized the boutique cigar world with an uncompromising commitment to quality. Every cigar is hand-rolled by skilled artisans using aged tobaccos sourced from the most fertile regions of Nicaragua, Honduras, and the Dominican Republic. With each draw, you get a taste of the meticulous care and tradition that goes into every blend. Timeless and elegant, the Vintage Series showcases aged Honduran tobaccos and smooth profiles that have become legendary. Whether it’s the earthy 1990, the creamy 1999, or the balanced 1992, each cigar in this series offers a mellow to medium-bodied experience with layered notes of cedar, espresso, and subtle spice. Created to mark ten years of excellence, Decade cigars deliver a rich, full-bodied profile with deep complexity. Expect notes of dark chocolate, toasted oak, and a bold finish that leaves a lasting impression. Crafted for those who prefer bolder flavor, the Sun Grown line features spicy, full-bodied cigars wrapped in sun-cured leaf. The Maduro variant intensifies the profile with deeper richness, offering hints of black pepper, cocoa, and roasted nuts.
specifications.Full-Bodied: Bold, rich, and complex with flavors like espresso, leather, and dark cocoa
specifications.Medium-Bodied: Balanced with notes of cedar, spice, and nuts
specifications.Mild & Creamy: Smooth, approachable, ideal for new smokers

specifications.name: Alec Bradley Connecticut Robusto
specifications.Product Description: What makes Alec Bradley a different story is the fact that Alan Rubin wasn’t born in a tobacco family. Even though this is not the only cigar company without a cigar history, the opposite is the case with many cigar conglomerates. Alan Rubin’s father (David Rubib), owned a nuts and bolts company named All Points Screw Company which Alan joined after completing university in 1983. In his 20s, he was introduced to cigars by his father’s friend which quickly sparked a passion for cigars. While working as a nuts and bolts guy, he took every opportunity to learn more about cigars. Alan Rubin’s business knack became apparent when he decided to specialise in hurricane roof fasteners following the 1992 Hurricane Andrew. This venture earned All Points Screws a pretty sum. After selling All Points Screws Company in 1996, Alan jumped at the opportunity to begin a cigar company. He named it Alec Bradley after his own sons. The name was actually in consideration to something his father said; it’s a good idea to have a company name that begins with “A” because it appears first in the business directory or the Yellow Pages. As a start, Alan Rubin imported and sold Bogey Cigars because he figured golfers will always want a smoke. Bogey’s Stogies did so-so especially because the cigar boom was coming to an end. Alan needed something sustainable. In the year 2000 Alan met and formed a partnership with Ralph Montero. Ralph owned his own line of cigars but he was struggling too. Since he had been in the business longer, Ralph had the experience and connections Alan needed, so the partnership served both parties well. To survive the difficult times, Alec Bradley made flavoured cigars for a while before embarking on premium handmade smokes. Meanwhile an important introduction to Henke Kelner happened. Shortly after Occidental Reserve was born. Occidental Reserve was the first real success for Alec Bradley. They named it Occidental to honour “Henke” Kelner the blender and owner of Occidental Cigar Factory in the Dominican Republic. Hendrik Kelner also works with big names like AVO and Davidoff.

specifications.name: Alec Bradley Tempus Inceptio
specifications.Product Description: What makes Alec Bradley a different story is the fact that Alan Rubin wasn’t born in a tobacco family. Even though this is not the only cigar company without a cigar history, the opposite is the case with many cigar conglomerates. Alan Rubin’s father (David Rubib), owned a nuts and bolts company named All Points Screw Company which Alan joined after completing university in 1983. In his 20s, he was introduced to cigars by his father’s friend which quickly sparked a passion for cigars. While working as a nuts and bolts guy, he took every opportunity to learn more about cigars. Alan Rubin’s business knack became apparent when he decided to specialise in hurricane roof fasteners following the 1992 Hurricane Andrew. This venture earned All Points Screws a pretty sum. After selling All Points Screws Company in 1996, Alan jumped at the opportunity to begin a cigar company. He named it Alec Bradley after his own sons. The name was actually in consideration to something his father said; it’s a good idea to have a company name that begins with “A” because it appears first in the business directory or the Yellow Pages. As a start, Alan Rubin imported and sold Bogey Cigars because he figured golfers will always want a smoke. Bogey’s Stogies did so-so especially because the cigar boom was coming to an end. Alan needed something sustainable. In the year 2000 Alan met and formed a partnership with Ralph Montero. Ralph owned his own line of cigars but he was struggling too. Since he had been in the business longer, Ralph had the experience and connections Alan needed, so the partnership served both parties well. To survive the difficult times, Alec Bradley made flavoured cigars for a while before embarking on premium handmade smokes. Meanwhile an important introduction to Henke Kelner happened. Shortly after Occidental Reserve was born. Occidental Reserve was the first real success for Alec Bradley. They named it Occidental to honour “Henke” Kelner the blender and owner of Occidental Cigar Factory in the Dominican Republic. Hendrik Kelner also works with big names like AVO and Davidoff.

Arturo Fuente Don Carlos Presidente is amongst the top of the ranks of the Arturo Fuente lines. Arturo Fuente Cigars are known for their exceptional quality and the Don Carlos line takes it a step further. The blend features the best of their Chateau Fuente grown selection of Dominican tobaccos aged for 10 years. Of course, with a great roll comes a great, razor sharp burn leaving behind a nice solid grey ash. The draw on the cigar is a little tight but comfortable giving it a nice slow burn (about an hour and 45 minute cigar) and a ton of smoke. name: Arturo Fuente Rosado Sungrown Magnum R 56

specifications.name: Arturo Fuente Rosado Sungrown Magnum R 56
specifications.Product Description:
The Arturo Fuente Rosado Sungrown Magnum R 56 is Carlos Fuente's idea of a good cigar and honestly, he couldn’t possibly any more correct. The construction of this cigar is near perfect. The beautiful Ecuadorian Sumatra wrapper, aged for 8 to 10 years, has a nice brown color with a reddish hue, hence the name, "Rosado" (which in Spanish means pinkish). The seams on this cigar are basically invisible; it has few small veins and almost looks like it’s covered in thin, fine leather. After being constructed these cigars sit for an extra year, aging to perfection. The burn is flawless but that’s expected from an Arturo Fuente cigar, and the ash is a beautiful solid white that holds on very well. The draw on this stick is great, producing a ton of smoke that will turn heads with its powerful yet, slightly sweet aroma.
The Arturo Fuente Rosado Sungrown Magnum R 56 isn't a powerhouse cigar but it is filled with flavor. This medium bodied smoke is quite complex, flaunting flavors of sweet cedar, a bit of leather, some roasted nuts and a long peppery finish. You can tell the blend was very carefully created because the flavors flow so well on the pallet, each complimenting the others perfectly. Everything about this cigar screams special but the price, which is inexplicably low given the quality of the cigar, but who’s complaining, right? Definitely one of Arturo Fuente's best, the Rosado Sungrown Magnum R 56 is a stick you will be sure to love.

"The Banker" by H. Upmann.

The Banker cigars by H. Upmann feature a diverse combination of Dominican and Nicaraguan longfillers with a broadleaf Nicaraguan binder and a hearty Ecuadorian Habano wrapper. H. The terminology “Angel’s Share” is used in the wine making process. When wine ages for long periods of time, some of it will evaporate which creates “Angel’s Share”. It suggests the belief that guardian angels that will watch over the wine, sample it and give their blessings. The Fuente family lost so much priceless, aged tobacco during the fire in 2012, the inspiration for this cigar came from that exact term. It is implied that the Angels enjoyed the alluring aroma from the tobacco that burned in the warehouses, but in turn, gave their blessings to the Fuente family for future successful endeavors.

name: Rocky Patel Private Cellar Toro Maduro

specifications.name: Rocky Patel Private Cellar Toro Maduro
specifications.Product Description: Rocky Patel Cigars are more than just a smoke—they’re a celebration of craftsmanship, passion, and refined taste. From the novice enthusiast to the seasoned aficionado, each cigar offers a balanced and luxurious experience designed to satisfy the senses. Established in the 1990s, Rocky Patel revolutionized the boutique cigar world with an uncompromising commitment to quality. Every cigar is hand-rolled by skilled artisans using aged tobaccos sourced from the most fertile regions of Nicaragua, Honduras, and the Dominican Republic. With each draw, you get a taste of the meticulous care and tradition that goes into every blend. Timeless and elegant, the Vintage Series showcases aged Honduran tobaccos and smooth profiles that have become legendary. Whether it’s the earthy 1990, the creamy 1999, or the balanced 1992, each cigar in this series offers a mellow to medium-bodied experience with layered notes of cedar, espresso, and subtle spice. Created to mark ten years of excellence, Decade cigars deliver a rich, full-bodied profile with deep complexity. Expect notes of dark chocolate, toasted oak, and a bold finish that leaves a lasting impression. Crafted for those who prefer bolder flavor, the Sun Grown line features spicy, full-bodied cigars wrapped in sun-cured leaf. The Maduro variant intensifies the profile with deeper richness, offering hints of black pepper, cocoa, and roasted nuts.

specifications.Product Description:
True to its name, the Romeo Y Julieta 1875 Bully packs a memorable punch. These cigars originate in the Dominican Republic and are a creation of Altadis, USA, who’s been in the cigar-making business since 1918. Over the course of these years, this company has perfected its manufacturing processes to deliver unique tobacco blends. Bully cigars are medium-bodied smokes that are 5-inches long with a ring gauge of 50. The well-aged Indonesian TBN wrapper imparts a light-colored look to each cigar. It also provides an exuberant aroma that is sure to deliver a satisfying smoking experience.
The Romeo Y Julieta cigars are crafted with Dominican fillers enclosed by binders from the same region. This tasteful cigar imparts the flavor of coffee and oak to the ensuing smoke. Make the most of these medium-bodied cigars by pairing them with light red wines such as Grenache Syrah Mourvedre and Merlot. These cigars are available in 5 pack.

specifications.name: Sabor Cubiche Cafe Con Leche
specifications.Product Description:
The Sabor Cubiche Café con Leche was handcrafted in Nicaragua by a good buddy of ours Jorge Leon. "Café con Leche" is a famous Spanish coffee that is steamed with milk to provide a smooth, rich taste and aroma. This one of a kind cigar is reminiscent of that wonderful, rich aroma from the moment you unwrap the cigar. Featuring a mellow smoke and an oily Connecticut wrapper and the best quality blend of aged long filler tobaccos, the Sabor Cubiche Café on leche cigar is not only incredibly satisfying, but highly aromatic with its infusion of dark roast coffee.
Size: 4 x 40
